\vspace{2pt}
\begin{minipage}{\textwidth}
\scriptsize
Pooled over all test windows (paysim). Graph: camouflage-filtered temporal GraphSAGE + DAE residual; Gate: \checkmark martingale e-process admission/rollback, auto = every candidate admitted, $\times$ = no KB; CRC: static / adaptive CS-ACRC four-action routing or binary approve/block; Rec.: TD-TPF post-incident recovery; Assist: retrieval-based analyst assist (off the decision path).\\
Net loss = realised policy loss $-$ recovered value + recovery cost (monetary units). Prevented: share of fraud value intercepted pre-settlement or recovered within the 24 h window. B3 adaptive, B4 and B5 branch from one fitted pipeline, so they share ranking metrics by construction.\\
\end{minipage}

\scriptsize
FAR: share of harmful (poisoned, Sybil, stale, conflicting) candidates ever admitted to the active KB. Admission test $H_0$: precision $\leq p_0$ = 0.50 at $\alpha_{admit}$ = 0.05; rollback test $H_0^{good}$: FPR $\leq q_0$ = 0.20 at $\alpha_{roll}$ = 0.05.\\
Rollback / TTR: harmful rules injected directly into the active KB; share rolled back and mean / max update cycles to rollback (8 verified firings per cycle).\\
Ville's inequality $P(\sup_t M_t \geq 1/\alpha) \leq \alpha$ = 0.05 under $H_0$: exact crossing probability over the horizon, Monte-Carlo rate with 95\% Clopper-Pearson interval, and the false-rollback rate of genuine rules inside the gate. \checkmark: bound satisfied by all three checks.\\
